headline: Synthetic Agent Workbench Turns Review Feedback into Reusable Skills
summary: This synthetic fixture models an agent workbench that runs a task, captures reviewer feedback, extracts a reusable procedure, validates it against acceptance criteria, and versions the accepted skill for later reuse.
why_it_matters: A visible feedback loop shows how non-technical users can improve agent behavior without relying on opaque memory or repeatedly rewriting instructions from scratch.
